ns2:section.sectionText: MCB 253 Section G is the Honors section for MCB Honors students and James Scholars. All other interested students should contact Shawna Naidu at shawna@illinois.edu for information and approval. Laboratories begin on Monday, August 22, 2011. MCB 253 Laboratory sections will not meet the week of September 5, 2011. Examinations will be held on Tuesday evenings from 7-9 pm on October 18, 2011 and November 29, 2011. Students who enter the University Fall 2011 or later are responsible for additional course-based tuition of $300 unless they are already paying differential tuition during the term of course enrollment.
